title: Biquandle Fares and Link Invariants
summary: We introduce a new family of invariants of oriented classical and virtual knots and links using fares, maps from paths in biquandle-colored diagrams to an abelian coefficient group. We consider the cases of 1-fares and 2-fares, provide examples to show that the enhancements are proper and end with some open questions about the cases of n-fares for n > 2.
